queryLines:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    uf.vehicle_prefix,
    uf.updates_count,
    uf.measured_intervals_count,
    uf.avg_update_interval_seconds,
    uf.stddev_update_interval_seconds,
    oc.continuity_support_ratio,
    oc.large_gaps_count,
    oc.max_gap_seconds,
    md.observed_dates_count,
    md.missing_dates_within_span_count,
    md.date_presence_ratio,
    md.total_observations_count,
    CASE
      WHEN uf.avg_update_interval_seconds IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN uf.avg_update_interval_seconds <= 30 THEN 1.0
      WHEN uf.avg_update_interval_seconds >= 300 THEN 0.0
      ELSE 1.0 - ((uf.avg_update_interval_seconds - 30.0) / 270.0)
    END AS update_regularity_score,
    LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(oc.continuity_support_ratio, 0.0), 0.0), 1.0) AS continuity_score,
    LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(md.date_presence_ratio, 0.0), 0.0), 1.0) AS multi_day_score
  FROM main.gold.gold_vehicle_update_frequency uf
  INNER JOIN main.gold.gold_vehicle_observation_continuity oc
    ON uf.vehicle_prefix = oc.vehicle_prefix
  INNER JOIN main.gold.gold_vehicle_multi_day_continuity md
    ON uf.vehicle_prefix = md.vehicle_prefix
  WHERE (
      :p_vehicle_prefix = 'ALL'
      OR CAST(uf.vehicle_prefix AS STRING) = :p_vehicle_prefix
    )
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROUND(((0.4 * COALESCE(update_regularity_score, 0.0)) + (0.3 * COALESCE(continuity_score, 0.0)) + (0.3 * COALESCE(multi_day_score, 0.0))) * 100.0, 2) AS quality_score,
    CASE
      WHEN ((0.4 * COALESCE(update_regularity_score, 0.0)) + (0.3 * COALESCE(continuity_score, 0.0)) + (0.3 * COALESCE(multi_day_score, 0.0))) * 100.0 >= 80 THEN 'Elite'
      WHEN ((0.4 * COALESCE(update_regularity_score, 0.0)) + (0.3 * COALESCE(continuity_score, 0.0)) + (0.3 * COALESCE(multi_day_score, 0.0))) * 100.0 >= 60 THEN 'Healthy'
      WHEN ((0.4 * COALESCE(update_regularity_score, 0.0)) + (0.3 * COALESCE(continuity_score, 0.0)) + (0.3 * COALESCE(multi_day_score, 0.0))) * 100.0 >= 40 THEN 'Watchlist'
      ELSE 'Critical'
    END AS quality_segment
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS vehicles_count,
  AVG(quality_score) AS avg_quality_score,
  AVG(avg_update_interval_seconds) AS avg_update_interval_seconds,
  AVG(continuity_support_ratio) AS avg_continuity_support_ratio,
  AVG(date_presence_ratio) AS avg_date_presence_ratio,
  SUM(CASE WHEN quality_segment = 'Elite' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS elite_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN quality_segment = 'Healthy' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS healthy_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN quality_segment = 'Watchlist' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS watchlist_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN quality_segment = 'Critical' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS critical_count
FROM scored
WHERE (
    :p_quality_segment = 'ALL'
    OR quality_segment = :p_quality_segment
  )

datasets.name: f606g707
queryLines:
SELECT
  vehicle_prefix
FROM (
  SELECT 'ALL' AS vehicle_prefix, 0 AS sort_order
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT CAST(vehicle_prefix AS STRING) AS vehicle_prefix, 1 AS sort_order
  FROM main.gold.gold_vehicle_update_frequency
  WHERE vehicle_prefix IS NOT NULL
) options
ORDER BY sort_order, vehicle_prefix

datasets.name: g707h808
queryLines:
SELECT quality_segment
FROM (
  SELECT 'ALL' AS quality_segment, 0 AS sort_order
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Elite' AS quality_segment, 1 AS sort_order
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Healthy' AS quality_segment, 2 AS sort_order
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Watchlist' AS quality_segment, 3 AS sort_order
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Critical' AS quality_segment, 4 AS sort_order
) options
ORDER BY sort_order, quality_segment
